provenance.summary: T5 encoder, static length 64: input_ids + pad bias in, 12 decoder-layer cross-attention K/V out.

source.precision: float16 weights; RMSNorm variance in float32

recordedFrom.recorder: bench/webnn/ir-record.js (Proxy around MLGraphBuilder; shapes are the backend's)
recordedFrom.label: intellitex-encoder-L64

folds: relative attention bias for a fixed L baked as a constant per encoder layer
decoder EncDecAttention K/V for all 12 layers hoisted into the encoder graph
RMSNorm variance computed in float32 (fp16 sum-of-squares of 1403*768 overflows)

note: One operand namespace: graph inputs keep their names, constants are k<N>, op results v<N>. Decode cache outputs are named *_out so they are distinct from the same-named inputs (WebNN will not bind one MLTensor as both).
